file_roles.evidence: applyVisibilityRules now tries glyphIndex(0x002d), then 0x2010, then 0x00ad instead of only '-'. A fallback chain for fonts lacking one glyph; the commit title says it handles macOS 11 test issues.

rationale: A CI test failed (textLength 4 vs 5) and the commit says to calculate hyphen width better in the test. The engine change is a glyph fallback, which may be real logic or only a defensive change.
notes: The test diff (not gold) would show whether the engine behavior or the test expectation was wrong.
